title: Qualify Orabona Theorem2.26 full finite-maximum subdifferential
head: codex/research-online-subgradient-max-migration
body:
Orabona v10 Theorem 2.26 now has a current source-qualified acceptance packet for the full equality between the subdifferential of a finite maximum and the ordinary convex hull of all active component subdifferentials. Every component is proper, convex and ambient-continuous at the common finite query. The proof constructs direction-dependent active support witnesses from actual maximizing components, compact subsequences and support limits, then uses strict separation. The terminal retains both inclusions and has no supplied witness, closed-hull replacement, global finiteness, bounded-domain or component closedness assumption.

This PR stacks on OPEN draft #172 at exact bd70b48eaff11accad19e5009efbdce3efd4b8c5. Seventeen retained proofs (one numbered terminal and sixteen foundations) and two complete retained definitions are source-qualified; no mathematical, TEST or registry declaration is added. The ordinary leading scope comment preserves every original raw mathematical byte. All nineteen headers, the complete old canary, shared roots/toolchain/dependencies and every other Book are preserved. Source: arXiv:1912.13213v10, printed18/PDF30, SHA256 cef4edfa97a6e063e53e9c532717c50aa156e5bc782ea49f969b3385011a1b17.

Distinct required formalizer, restricted decoder and anti-anchored reviewer completed CONTRACT/BODY/FINAL with explicit semantic deltas. These are automated roles, not human/external review or attested runtime model provenance. The maximum definition needs only an arbitrary ambient type and finite nonempty indexing; the active union has intrinsic real inner-product structure. Actual theorem/helper premises remain individually explicit. The shared global support predicate permits improper EReal inputs, while this source terminal supplies proper components and a common domain query. Positive infinity away from that query is permitted. The finite-dimensional inner-product formulation includes Euclidean instances; no separately certified coordinate conversion, algorithm, regret or measurable selection guarantee is claimed.

Current root 9089 jobs, Tests 9234 jobs and full harness 466 tests / 7 existing skips pass (cached jobs included). All nineteen old canary proofs and two TEST definitions, forty unique standard-foundation kernel checks and nineteen native header guards pass. The scalar canary checks fractional hull membership, a strict active component and an extended indicator domain; no new or 2D Max canary is claimed. Selected graph: 40 nodes, 3402 direct type/value occurrences, 21 required producer/canary pairs; readiness: 19 nodes, 1795 occurrences, 16 pairs. These are separate selected graphs, not the full registry. All10811 shared IDs/URLs remain with nineteen canonical public links, five highlights, four curated links, three notation entries and one source card.

Exact stacked-base contributor/scoped whitespace, 66489 historical raw bindings, task-only shadow, clean local lean-verified site/check/registry and actual first-viewport/full-source-card MathJax rendering pass separately. Global SGB remains unchanged. Recorded repair attempts concern qualified Filter API retrieval, monomorphic type-output parsing, evidence-variable shadowing and a contribution-schema prefix; original failures and unused pre-use corrections remain. No mathematical statement/body/canary was repaired or weakened. A separate origin/main contributor diagnostic still fails for nine OTHER mandatory Chapter1 contract gaps; this PR does not waive them.

Actual command gates remain distinct from file/prompt/role conventions; no single runtime enforces the whole workflow.

Only this bounded Theorem2.26 package is accepted/compiled-local/PR-ready. Legacy3->2 applies only to OnlineSubgradientMax after actual PR delivery. Next Example2.27 hinge and all remaining Chapter1/2 maintext and necessary appendix obligations remain REQUIRED; Chapter2 mandatory total is null/incomplete, Chapters3-16 unenumerated, total Goal ACTIVE. No merge, deployment, canonical main/live update or worktree retirement.
